changelog:
Pro can be bought by period. The app now offers five periods — 1, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months — and the server, not the client, supplies the period and its price: ₽149 for a month, ₽447 for three, ₽894 for six, ₽1,341 for nine, ₽1,490 for a year (10 × monthly — the only discount). Checkout accepts exactly the periods the person sees on screen, so the plan picker and the payment can no longer drift apart.

Payment opens a live YooKassa page; the app confirms the payment itself and activates Pro. If the page cannot be opened, the purchase does not start and the person sees why.

Updates preserve data: same signature, install over the previous build — chats, contacts, groups, channels, settings and purchased tokens stay in place.

Acceptance: APK 0.1.287 on Android 15 (emulator), installed over 0.1.285, no crashes, five periods with server prices on screen, session and keys alive after the update.
notes: Install the APK manually; store versions will follow later.
